title: Wire SceneEventBroker into server lifecycle
description:
Integrate broker into DzScriptServerPane start/stop.

Changes to DzScriptServerPane.h:
- Add: SceneEventBroker* m_pEventBroker;

Changes to DzScriptServerPane.cpp:

onStartClicked() / server start path:
- Instantiate m_pEventBroker = new SceneEventBroker(this)
- Call m_pEventBroker->start() -- connects to DzScene signals
- Register GET /scene/events route, passing m_pEventBroker to handler lambda

onStopClicked() / server stop path:
- Call m_pEventBroker->stop() -- disconnects signals, closes all subscriber queues (so SSE handlers exit cleanly)
- delete m_pEventBroker; m_pEventBroker = nullptr;

Server stop must drain SSE handlers before returning. stop() should call queue->close() on all registered queues and then briefly wait (or just let handler threads exit naturally -- httplib will wait for handlers on server stop).
close_reason: SceneEventBroker wired into startServer() (instantiate + start) and stopServer() (stop + delete) in DzScriptServerPane.cpp; m_pEventBroker member added to header

title: SSE endpoint GET /scene/events
description:
Add SSE handler in DzScriptServerPane.cpp (alongside existing handlers).

Route: GET /scene/events

Query params:
- filter= comma-separated list of categories: node,skeleton,light,camera,selection,scene,time,render
  Default (omitted): all categories enabled

Handler logic:
1. Check auth (reuse existing token validation)
2. Check IP whitelist (reuse existing check)
3. Parse ?filter= into bitmask
4. Set response headers: Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive
5. Create SubscriberQueue, register with m_pEventBroker
6. Loop:
   a. pop(15000) -- 15s timeout
   b. If empty (timeout): write ':keepalive\n\n', flush -- client detects disconnect on failed flush
   c. If event: write 'data: <json>\n\n', flush
   d. If flush fails (client gone): break
7. Unregister SubscriberQueue from broker, delete queue

Note: httplib keeps the handler alive for the duration -- this is a long-running handler, same pattern as the existing long-poll result handler.
close_reason: SSE handler added to setupRoutes() in DzScriptServerPane.cpp: auth check, filter parsing, SubscriberQueue lifecycle, chunked content provider loop with keepalive

title: Debounce timers for high-frequency signals
description:
Add debounce logic inside SceneEventBroker for signals that fire at high frequency.

Signals needing debounce:
1. timeChanging() -- fires every frame during playback (~30-60fps)
   Strategy: on timeChanging, start/restart a 150ms QTimer (single-shot)
   On timer fire: emit one time.changed event with current scene time
   On timeChanged() (manual scrub): emit immediately, cancel timer

2. nodeSelectionListChanged() -- can burst during multi-select
   Strategy: 50ms debounce, coalesce into single selection.list_changed

Implementation:
- QTimer* m_pTimeDebounce (150ms, single-shot)
- QTimer* m_pSelectionDebounce (50ms, single-shot)
- Both owned by SceneEventBroker (main thread), so no thread-safety issues
- Store pending time value so debounced slot has current value on fire
close_reason: Implemented in SceneEventBroker.cpp: 150ms debounce for timeChanging, 50ms for nodeSelectionListChanged

title: JSON event serialization for all event types
description:
Implement serializeEvent() in SceneEventBroker for each signal category.

Output format per event:
  {"type":"node.added","ts":1716307200123,"data":{...}}

Event types and their data payloads:
- scene.loading, scene.loaded, scene.saving, scene.saved(filename), scene.clear_starting, scene.cleared
- node.added(node_id, node_name, node_type), node.removed(node_id, node_name), node.list_changed
- skeleton.added(node_id, node_name), skeleton.removed(node_id, node_name)
- light.added(node_id, node_name, node_type), light.removed(node_id, node_name)
- camera.added(node_id, node_name), camera.removed(node_id, node_name)
- selection.list_changed, selection.primary_changed(node_id, node_name) -- empty data{} if null
- time.changed(time_value, fps), playback.started, playback.finished
- render.started, render.finished

Use existing JsonBuilder for safe serialization. Extract node_id via node->getElementID() or similar DAZ SDK call -- verify exact method name against SDK headers.
close_reason: Implemented in SceneEventBroker.cpp: makeEvent(), nodeInfoJson(), per-slot JsonBuilder calls for all event types

title: SceneEventBroker and SubscriberQueue classes
description:
Create include/SceneEventBroker.h and src/SceneEventBroker.cpp.

SceneEventBroker (QObject, main thread):
- Connects to dzApp->getScene() signals via Qt::DirectConnection on start()
- Disconnects all signals on stop()
- Maintains QMutex-protected list of SubscriberQueue*
- registerSubscriber(queue, filter_mask) and unregisterSubscriber(queue)
- Internal: serializeEvent(type, data) -> QString JSON

SubscriberQueue (one per SSE client):
- QMutex + QWaitCondition + std::deque<QString>
- push(const QString& event) -- called from main thread
- pop(int timeout_ms) -> QString -- called from HTTP thread, blocks
- close() -- signals the queue is done (server stopping)

Filter mask: bitmask of event categories (node, selection, scene, time, render, light, camera, skeleton).
close_reason: SceneEventBroker + SubscriberQueue in include/SceneEventBroker.h and src/SceneEventBroker.cpp
